submission.natural_language_explanation: L4/H7 copies one earlier token: at every position it puts 0.93-1.0 of its attention on a single earlier position, and its strength is how far that token's value lies from its mean write, which is the head's mean opening-token write - so a text's own first token always reads 0.0-0.2 and is never the peak, and copying a sentence-final period also stays at the floor. Attention leaves the opening token for a content word only where the context repeats something: at the second occurrence of a proper name, or of a function word whose earlier successor was a numeral, it copies the token that followed the earlier copy; at a comma or semicolon separator inside a list of ordinary lowercase items it copies the item just read; in code, markup, JSON or SQL it copies an identifier or symbol (0.5-1.1 at ordinary content words, 1.2-2.0 at rare name pieces, numerals, byte fragments and symbols) - so a repeated proper name (8/8 in my probes), a 3+ item lowercase comma list (about 4 in 5) and a code/markup/JSON/SQL line (about 5 in 6) cross the line even at 10-20 tokens, plain prose needs 25+ tokens to cross (about 3 in 4 passages, but how-to and recipe text only about 1 in 3), while single plain sentences of 9-18 tokens with no repeated content word (about 1 in 7 crosses, weakly) and sentence-initial comma lists of five to eight people's surnames (about 1 in 10) stay at the floor, as do two-sentence plain passages whose only repeat is a common noun or the closing period.

rival_explanations: A broad repetition reading: any repeated token is enough to lift the head, so a prose passage that repeats a common noun ('the garden ... the garden') or a list that repeats only its commas is predicted active.

A token-rarity reading: only rare pieces move the head, so an ordinary lowercase comma list (milk, eggs, bread) and a repeated function word with a numeral successor ('in 1885 ... in 1962') are predicted inactive.
A length reading: activity is a function of probe length alone, so the 42-token recipe is predicted active and the 9-token shopping list inactive.
